name: Fenwick's Head
summary: Forsaken rogues seek Fenwick Thatros along the shores of Lordamere Lake. His head is proof of his execution, claimed on orders passed down from Lord Varimathras.

sections.title: A Contract from the Shadows
sections.body: Mennet Carkad acts from the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity on urgent intelligence from dreadlord Varimathras. Fenwick Thatros, a hostile undead leader, has established a foothold near the decaying docks along Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest. To keep him from rallying hostile undead against the Forsaken, Carkad sends promising Deathstalkers to find and kill him, then bring back his head as proof.

sections.title: A Rite of Passage
sections.body: For Deathstalker operatives, bringing Fenwick's Head to Carkad is a trial beyond collecting a bounty. The severed head proves a rogue's skill in infiltration and assassination. Success opens the way to deeper, more specialized instruction in the shadow arts from Forsaken masters.

faq.answer: Lord Varimathras identified Fenwick Thatros as an undead leader entrenched in Silverpine Forest. Near the decrepit docks of Lordamere Lake, he posed an immediate danger to Forsaken interests in the region.
Mennet Carkad, a Deathstalker trainer in the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter, demands Fenwick's Head on an urgent order passed down from Lord Varimathras.
Deathstalker scouts place Fenwick Thatros by the decrepit docks on the shore of Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why must his head be severed?
faq.answer: Mennet Carkad requires physical proof that the threat has been eliminated before advancing an operative to advanced shadow training.

angles.text: As a rogue, claiming Fenwick's Head marks a rising Forsaken operative as a reliable Deathstalker and earns access to advanced training.
As an undead, you see the Forsaken ruthlessly suppress rival undead factions contesting control of Silverpine Forest and the shores of Lordamere Lake.
